correctness.rationale: The single-jump oracle computes exact finite branching by finitely many Sigma^0_1(X) existence tests, then all modal formulas by total syntax recursion. Singleton k needs no jump. The X-computable padded frame has k mandatory successors at every world and precisely l-k optional distinct dummy successors only at testing worlds corresponding to first halting stages, hence exclusively permitted degrees k,l. At s_e, not Box p is equivalent to e belonging to X-prime; extraction for arbitrary X yields ACA_0. Handles k=0 and all finite S.

value.rationale: A complete natural reverse-mathematical classification by permitted finite outdegree spectra, including all serial pairs, identifies the exact fragile boundary between provability in RCA_0 and equivalence to ACA_0. It also determines optimal oracle complexity uniformly for arbitrary modal nesting depth, with a depth-one witness. These structural distinctions do not follow merely from the existence of the general image-finite reverse-mathematics theorem.
